name: Portsea Front Beach
signature: The Peninsula's most exclusive bay beach — calm water, brilliant visibility for snorkelling, and a summer crowd that has been coming here for decades
editorNote:
Portsea Front Beach is the calm bay side of Portsea — sheltered, clear-watered, and one of the best snorkelling spots on the Peninsula thanks to the rocky reef that extends from the pier. The visibility on a calm day is remarkable, and the mix of reef fish, weedy sea dragons, and occasional dolphin encounter makes it a genuinely rewarding entry-level snorkel.

Portsea SLSC patrols through summer. The club runs a strong Nippers program on Sunday mornings — the smallest and arguably most community-focused of the tip clubs, with a tight-knit membership that reflects the Portsea summer community.

The front beach is calm and safe for swimming; the back beach five minutes away is for surfers and ocean swimmers. The Portsea Hotel overlooks the pier — post-swim drinks with the bay view is one of the Peninsula's better afternoon rituals.
whyWeGo: The clearest bay water on the Peninsula and the best casual snorkelling without a boat.
ifOnlyOneThing: Bring a mask and snorkel. The reef off the pier is worth 30 minutes of slow exploration.
